# DemandMatch

> DemandMatch matches your inventory with your customers' demand, automatically. Software for distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods: more sales, better margin, and your sales team only approves.

DemandMatch is sales software for B2B distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods, founded in Berlin by Richard von Waldow and Bing Cai.
It reads the systems a distributor already runs (ERP such as SAP, Oracle, Odoo or DATEV; CRM such as HubSpot; the inbox; messengers) read-only, and matches inventory with customer demand in both directions:

- Demand finds stock: for every request from email, phone or CRM it finds the right material, warehouse and margin and prepares the offer.
- Stock finds demand: for overstock and inbound goods it finds the customers who buy exactly that and prepares a personal message for each.

A person in sales approves everything before it goes out. Companies start with a free fit check, then a value assessment and a 30-day pilot on their real data. Contact: hello@waldowautomation.com.

## Pricing

All prices net (excl. VAT in Europe, excl. sales tax in the US). Every paid step is credited in full to the next one.

- Fit check (30 minutes): Free
- Value assessment (3 weeks): €20,000 / $22,000
- Pilot (30 days): €60,000 / $66,000
- License Division (To start with one division): €180,000 / $198,000 per year, plus implementation from €60,000 / $66,000 one-time. One business unit or one country; revenue in scope up to €400m; sales users up to 60.
- License Group (Typical at about €1bn revenue): €450,000 / $495,000 per year, plus implementation from €150,000 / $165,000 one-time. All divisions and countries; revenue in scope up to €2bn; sales users up to 500.
- License Global (For groups with several companies): from €600,000 / $660,000 per year, plus implementation from €150,000 / $165,000 one-time. Several ERP systems, single sign-on, a dedicated contact; revenue in scope above €2bn; sales users by agreement.
- Every license includes: matching both ways, offers with margin, freight and your pricing rules, read-only connection to ERP, CRM and inbox, and nothing goes out without your team's approval.
- Paid annually in advance, 12-month minimum term. The value assessment and the pilot are credited in full.
- Business case calculator: https://demandmatch.io/en/#roi
